question: Find the compound interest on ₹25,000 for 2 years at the rate of 10% per annum when the interest is compounded annually.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹25,000

Rate (r) = 10% per annum

Time (t) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P(1+(r)/(100))^t - 1 

**Calculation:**

CI = 25000(1+(10)/(100))² - 1 <
